name: Excruciating Discord makes Discordance crit under Chronological (#2187)
contract: Excruciating Discord 582356's tooltip reads "Your Discordances used with Chronological are now guaranteed to critically strike." In Spell.dbc the talent is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER (107) with EffectMiscValue 12 (SPELLMOD_EFFECT2), EffectBasePoints 99 + DieSides 1 = +100, EffectSpellClassMask [0,0,16384], which inside SpellFamilyName 28 selects Chronological 542728 and nothing else. Chronological's Effect[1] is SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER EffectMiscValue 7 (SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE) with EffectBasePoints -1 + DieSides 1 = 0, masked [33554432,0,0], which selects Discordance (503875-503880, 582758-582760); its Effect[0] is the SPELLMOD_CASTING_TIME -100% that makes Discordance instant, which is what "used with Chronological" means. Unit::ApplyEffectModifiers routes SPELLMOD_EFFECT2 to effect index 1 (Unit.cpp), raising the crit modifier to 100, and Unit::SpellDoneCritChance consumes SPELLMOD_CRITICAL_CHANCE (Unit.cpp). The modifier is flat, so the percent-only HasSpellModApplied early return in Player::ApplySpellMod does not apply and the only guard is the totalflat >= 100 check that forbids a second 100-point crit modifier. Generic core machinery. This scenario is a regression guard for behaviour that already works.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Chronological's crit modifier before the talent
Discordance's crit chance with no Chronological
Untalented, Chronological's crit modifier resolves to zero
Chronological's crit modifier resolves to 100 with the talent
That is exactly +100 against the baseline
The talent alone does not make Discordance crit
Fixture Chronological on the talented player
Discordance is now guaranteed to crit
Chronological added exactly 100 points of crit chance
Without Chronological the bonus is gone, as the tooltip conditions it
